summary: Learn to rank initiatives, allocate capacity, and track KPIs using Hoshin Kanri, OKRs, and scorecards. Explore the 5-day course.
lede: Strategic prioritisation is the process of ranking initiatives against objectives, value, feasibility, risk, and available capacity. For strategy analysts, portfolio managers, and performance leads, this course builds practical skills for turning objectives into ranked initiatives and tracking delivery. You practise weighted scoring, mapping objectives to KPIs and OKRs, analysing capacity and trade-offs, and shaping performance reviews and dashboard specifications.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who translate organizational strategy into ranked initiatives, resource choices, and performance reviews. It suits intermediate practitioners who contribute to planning or monitor execution. This course is designed for: Strategy analysts who translate objectives into ranked initiatives and measures. Portfolio managers who balance investment proposals against capacity and strategic fit. Performance management leads who coordinate KPI reviews and corrective actions. Business planning managers who connect annual plans with operational commitments. PMO leads who track dependencies, ownership, and initiative delivery status. Corporate performance analysts who maintain scorecards and investigate KPI variance. Transformation leads who sequence change initiatives against workforce capacity. Department heads who negotiate priorities across operational plans and strategic objectives. Finance business partners who test initiative costs against available budgets. Executive office advisers who prepare priority reviews and decision briefs.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational objectives, KPIs, or planning and reporting cycles is expected. No coding is required; advanced scenario analysis and dashboard topics receive operational-level treatment.
